title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 27
description: Ten questions on Matthew 27: Jesus before Pilate, the end of Judas, Barabbas released, the crucifixion, and the new tomb.

questions.text: To whom did the chief priests and elders deliver Jesus up, bound?
questions.explanation: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

answers.text: Pontius Pilate, the governor
Caiaphas, the high priest
The whole council of the elders
The centurion and his soldiers

questions.text: What did Judas do with the thirty pieces of silver?
questions.explanation: Feeling remorse, he brought the silver back and said he had betrayed innocent blood; then he threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary, departed, and hanged himself.

answers.text: He buried them in the potter's field
He gave them away to the poor
He threw them down in the sanctuary
He kept them and fled from the city

questions.text: What was the field bought with those pieces of silver called?
questions.explanation: The chief priests bought the potter's field with the silver, to bury strangers in, and therefore that field was called The Field of Blood.

answers.text: The Field of Jeremiah
The Field of Blood
The Field of Strangers
The Field of Silver

questions.text: Which prisoner did the multitudes ask Pilate to release?
questions.explanation: The chief priests and elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas, and when the governor asked which of the two he should release, they said Barabbas.

answers.text: Simon of Cyrene
One of the two robbers
Jesus, who is called Christ
Barabbas

questions.text: What did Pilate do before the multitude when he saw that nothing was being gained?
questions.explanation: He took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying that he was innocent of the blood of this righteous person.

answers.text: He left the judgment seat at once
He called for more witnesses to come
He washed his hands before the multitude
He sent word to his wife about it

questions.text: What did the governor's soldiers put on Jesus in the Praetorium?
questions.explanation: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him, braided a crown of thorns for his head, and put a reed in his right hand.

answers.text: A scarlet robe and a crown of thorns
A white garment and a wooden staff
The clothes of a soldier of the guard
A linen cloth and a sealed stone

questions.text: Whom did they compel to carry his cross?
questions.explanation: As they came out they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and compelled him to go with them to carry his cross.

answers.text: One of the two robbers
Simon, a man of Cyrene
A servant of the high priest
Joseph from Arimathaea

questions.text: What happened from the sixth hour until the ninth hour?
questions.explanation: From the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.

answers.text: The soldiers divided his clothing
A great wind rose over the land
The multitudes went away silent
There was darkness over all the land

questions.text: What happened to the veil of the temple when Jesus yielded up his spirit?
questions.explanation: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom, the earth quaked, and the rocks were split.

answers.text: It was torn in two from the top to the bottom
It was taken away by the priests
It was burned in the fire of the altar
It was covered with the scarlet robe

questions.text: Who asked Pilate for the body of Jesus and laid it in his own new tomb?
questions.explanation: Joseph, a rich man from Arimathaea who was also Jesus' disciple, asked Pilate for the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth, and laid it in his own new tomb cut out in the rock.

answers.text: The centurion who watched him
Joseph, a rich man from Arimathaea
Simon of Cyrene
One of the chief priests
